title: Section header
description: The header row of a discovery or gallery section: a 20 / 500 title, an optional muted line, an actions slot on the right (usually a ghost "Xem tất cả" Button) and an optional ‹ › pager of subtle icon buttons that scrolls a rail or calls your handlers, disabled at the ends.
when: Above a rail or a grid of MediaCards on a discovery, home or gallery page.
A section that links to its full list ("Xem tất cả") or pages through a row of cards (‹ ›).

instead.need: A section of a work page with its content
A group label in a form or a side panel

a11y: The title is an h2 (headingLevel 3 inside another section); give the section aria-labelledby={id} with the same id.

The pager is a group named by the title; its buttons are named "Mục trước" / "Mục sau" (locale prevItem / nextItem, or prevLabel / nextLabel) and are disabled at the start / end, so Tab skips them there. Enter or Space presses them.
With target, a press scrolls the rail by one visible width (instantly under prefers-reduced-motion); cards scrolled off screen stay reachable with Tab.
notes: It renders the existing Button only: the actions are your Buttons, the pager is two Button iconOnly variant="subtle" size="sm" shape="round" (44px on a touch phone). No colours or sizes of its own.

pager={{ target: ref }} reads the rail after mount (the server HTML has ‹ disabled and › enabled) and follows its scroll and size; the ref can point at the scroll container or at an element that contains one (a Carousel's wrapper, though a Carousel shows its own arrows from sm).
pager={{ onPrev, onNext, prevDisabled, nextDisabled }} for anything else (pages of data, a carousel of yours).

examples.title: Title, description and Xem tất cả
Pager over a rail of MediaCards
examples.description: The rail recipe: phones show 75% wide cards (the next one peeks), 3 per view from sm, 4 from lg. ‹ › scroll it by one view and turn off at the ends.
